entities.summary: Feodosy Nikolayevich Chernyshov or Feodosii Nikolaevich Chernyshev was a geologist and a paleontologist. He was among the first to produce high resolution geological maps of the Urals region where he discovered Devonian strata. Chernyshev was an Honorary Member of Russian and Foreign Learned Societies.
